name: DocuWare
description: DocuWare document management: search file cabinets by field, read document metadata and index fields, list cabinets, dialogs and trays. Platform REST API, OAuth 2.0 token from the DocuWare Identity Service (DocuWare Cloud or an on-premises server).
instructions:
**Getting access**
1. Create a DocuWare user for the integration with read rights on the file cabinets the agent should see. DocuWare enforces cabinet and field-level rights, so a restricted user sees fewer documents rather than an error.
2. Set `DOCUWARE_URL` to your platform root — for DocuWare Cloud that is `https://<tenant>.docuware.cloud/DocuWare/Platform`; on premises it is `https://<server>/DocuWare/Platform`. No trailing slash.
3. Set `DOCUWARE_USERNAME` and `DOCUWARE_PASSWORD`.
4. Set `DOCUWARE_TOKEN_URL` to the token endpoint of your DocuWare **Identity Service**. To find it, open `<DOCUWARE_URL>/Home/IdentityServiceInfo` in a browser: it returns an `IdentityServiceUrl`. Append `/connect/token` to it (the exact value is the `token_endpoint` in `<IdentityServiceUrl>/.well-known/openid-configuration`).
   - DocuWare Cloud: `https://login-emea.docuware.cloud/<organization-guid>/connect/token` (the host can differ by region).
   - On premises: usually `https://<server>/DocuWare/Identity/connect/token`.

**Authentication is OAuth 2.0 via the Identity Service.** DocuWare retired the old cookie logon: `/Account/Logon` now answers `410 Gone` with "Use Identity Service for authentication". The adapter requests an access token with the password grant (`client_id=docuware.platform.net.client`, `scope=docuware.platform`) and sends it as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Tokens live 60 minutes; the adapter renews them before they expire and again on a 401. AnythingMCP stores the token in the encrypted `connector_auth_cache` table. If your organisation has disabled the password grant, register an app under **Configuration → Integrations → App registration** and build a custom OAuth 2.0 connector instead.

**Everything hangs off a file cabinet id.** Call `docuware_list_file_cabinets` first; the `Id` it returns (a GUID) is the `fileCabinetId` every other tool needs. A DocuWare installation typically has several, and searching the wrong one returns a confident empty result.

**Search is by index field, not full text by default.** `docuware_search_documents` takes DocuWare's `q` expression over index fields, e.g. `DOCUMENT_TYPE=Invoice`. Full-text search only works if the cabinet has a full-text index configured. `count` is capped at 10,000 by DocuWare.

**What has been checked.** The resource paths and query parameters were checked against the URI templates a live DocuWare Platform publishes, and the token flow against a live Identity Service's OpenID configuration. The tools have not been run with real credentials, and the exact `q` quoting rules are not confirmed: if a search with quotes returns nothing, try the value without quotes.

**Read-only by design**: no upload, no index change, no delete. DocuWare cabinets are usually the company's audit-relevant archive.

tools.name: docuware_list_file_cabinets
tools.description: List the file cabinets and document trays the logged-in user can reach, with their GUID, name and whether each is a basket. Start here — every other tool needs one of these ids.

tools.name: docuware_get_file_cabinet
tools.description: Read one file cabinet's definition: its index fields, their types and lengths, and the dialogs configured on it. Needed before composing a search.

tools.name: docuware_search_documents
tools.description: Search one file cabinet by index field, e.g. `DOCUMENT_TYPE=Invoice`. Full-text only works where the cabinet has a full-text index.

q.description: DocuWare query expression over index fields, e.g. COMPANY="Muster GmbH".

count.description: Maximum documents to return (DocuWare caps this at 10,000).

sortOrder.description: Field to sort by with Asc or Desc appended, e.g. `DWSTOREDATETIME Desc`.

tools.name: docuware_get_document
tools.description: Read one document's header: its id, store date, content type, page count and the section list.

docId.description: Numeric document id within that cabinet.

tools.name: docuware_get_document_fields
tools.description: Read the index fields of one document with their values — the invoice number, supplier, amount and date DocuWare has captured for it.

tools.name: docuware_list_dialogs
tools.description: List the search, store and result dialogs configured on a file cabinet. Dialogs define which fields a user may search and see.

tools.name: docuware_get_organization
tools.description: Read the DocuWare organization the user belongs to: its name, GUID and the services available on this platform.
